title: In 1969, a Nevada man built a desert home from junk; today, Thunder Mountain is a free attraction
summary_full: Thunder Mountain Monument in Nevada features sculptures created from discarded materials by Frank Van Zant. This unique roadside attraction developed from his personal vision to honor Native American history. After a fire in 1983, the site faced preservation challenges until it was recognized as a historic site in 1992. The monument is maintained today with visitor donations and a caretaker's assistance.
